subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and if so should it be a new `/admin/update` endpoint or an intentional Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The requested endpoint would expand host package-update and restart authority from existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths to an HTTP surface, which needs maintainer intent for auth scope, trusted ingress assumptions, auditability, rate limiting, and failure-mode guarantees.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose via Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the disabled-by-default Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, and handoff proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane surfaces and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared history across Admin HTTP RPC, gateway update flow, and adjacent version resolution.
